author: Marco92
quote: Years of Waiting for This? An Unacceptable DisappointmentScore: 0/10After years of development, endless delays, massive marketing campaigns, and promises of revolutionary gaming, this is what we are supposed to accept?Players waited for years, built up expectations, and invested their excitement in what was supposed to be one of the greatest video games ever made. Yet bugs and technical issues undermine the **** can a company with Rockstar’s resources, experience, and financial power justify releasing a game with such problems after so many years of development?Time, money, and hype mean absolutely nothing if the final product fails to meet basic standards of quality. Players are not paying for promises, cinematic trailers, or a legendary name. They are paying for a properly finished game.Rockstar needs to understand that its reputation does not make it immune to criticism. Years of waiting should have resulted in excellence, not **** enormous amount of hype, years of development, and still an unacceptable result. Completely disappointing. 0/10.
